summary: Iteration 2 (Phase 3 admin dashboard + design overhaul) tested end-to-end. Backend: 25/25 pytest cases pass (all 16 prior + 9 new admin endpoint tests). Frontend: staff login, admin sidebar (9 items), dashboard stats/Quick Actions, Requests inbox w/ Accept & Decline, Orders table, Task Board w/ In-Queue column, Settings inputs, Sign Out clearing localStorage, and unauth /admin -> /staff/login redirect all verified. Homepage: hero-mascot scale-125 md+, numbers-section w/ 4 stats, 5 feature tiles all using uploaded PNG assets, varied pricing cards (dark logo-design + dashed custom-commission), FAQ list-style w/ 7 items, black footer w/ mascot. Lenis smooth-scroll active (html.lenis) with prefers-reduced-motion emulation correctly skipping init.

ui_bugs.issue: Route uses title="Calendar / Queue" which generates data-testid="admin-placeholder-calendar-/-queue" instead of the spec's expected data-testid="admin-placeholder-calendar". Placeholder itself renders correctly; only the testid selector deviates. Consider passing a separate testid slug prop or renaming title to "Calendar".

action_items: (Optional/Low) Fix Calendar placeholder testid — either rename title to 'Calendar' or add a dedicated slug prop so the exact data-testid 'admin-placeholder-calendar' is emitted.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py 676 lines — still monolithic; consider splitting admin routes into their own router module once Phase 4 begins to keep files <700 lines.

admin_update_order_status reads full order, appends to activity list in Python, then $set the whole array — race-condition-prone under concurrent PATCHes. Prefer $push {activity: entry} atomic update.

admin_dashboard_summary compares updated_at (ISO string) with month_start (ISO string) lexicographically — works for well-formed UTC ISO strings but is fragile if a document ever stores a naive/offset-shifted timestamp. Consider storing datetime objects or using aggregation.
Lenis instance/prefers-reduced-motion behavior looks correct; no cleanup issues observed.
Frontend Task Board 'Next' arrow on last column disabled state was not explicitly verified in this run (no order currently in the last column) — main agent can self-verify.

success_rate.frontend: ~99% (1 minor testid mismatch on Calendar placeholder)

seed_data_creation: Created several TEST_AcceptFlow request docs + auto-created orders via /api/admin/requests/{id}/accept during pytest run. Prior TEST_User/TEST_Playwright/TEST_WithFile from iteration 1 preserved.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend admin surface is stable and fully covered by pytest. Only outstanding cosmetic gap: Calendar placeholder testid does not match spec ('admin-placeholder-calendar-/-queue' vs 'admin-placeholder-calendar'). Phase 4 (payments), Phase 5 (showcase automation), and Phase 6 (magic-link + realtime + SMTP) still deferred.
